name: Remedy of Arugal
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Dalar Dawnweaver seeks Arugal's spell to learn how his worgen magic works.

sections.title: A Mage's Leftovers
sections.body: Before taking Shadowfang Keep, Archmage Arugal sheltered at an abandoned wheat farm north of the river bridge in Silverpine Forest. He recorded his strange arts in spellbooks left among the farm tools and rotting floorboards. One scroll, the Remedy of Arugal, describes early methods and magical formulas from his experiments with the transmutations that cursed the local people.

sections.title: Forsaken Scrutiny
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver, a Forsaken spellcaster at the Sepulcher, thinks little of Arugal's standing and considers his intellect fragile and transparent. Still, Dawnweaver needs to understand the worgen curse's workings. Recovering the Remedy gives Forsaken agents the arcane knowledge Dawnweaver seeks to counter Arugal's spreading menace and secure Silverpine for Lady Sylvanas.

faq.q: What is the Remedy of Arugal?
faq.answer: The Remedy of Arugal is a spell written by the renegade mage Arugal. It records the arcane methods he used in his first experiments with worgen magic in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Where was the Remedy left behind?
aliases: where to find remedy of arugal
faq.answer: Arugal left the Remedy in dusty spellbooks on the upper floor of an abandoned wheat farm, just north of the river bridge in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Dalar Dawnweaver want this spell?
aliases: why does dalar want the remedy
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver wants to study the magic Arugal used so the Forsaken can find ways to counter it and secure Silverpine.

faq.q: Who guards the spellbooks at the farm?
faq.answer: Arugal's lupine thralls infest the farm. When someone disturbs the dusty spellbooks on the second floor, a Moonrage Darkrunner leaps out to defend its master's belongings.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you may share Dalar Dawnweaver's disdain for Arugal's clumsy, reckless experiments, while seeing the danger in unchecked summoning magic.
As Forsaken, you help secure this spell as an early, vital step against the feral worgen threatening Silverpine Forest's borders.
